title: Weapon proficiency perk shaping rules
description: Costs, requirements and rollable effects for Shape, Refine, Reshape and Clear. Semantics are enforced by 'python -m tools.proficiency_split validate', which the Repository Audit job runs on every change; this schema is for editor autocomplete.

_comment.description: Free-form notes. Ignored by the engine and by the validator.

RequiresProtectionZone.description: Whether shaping operations are restricted to protection zones, as on the official servers. Defaults to true.

Slots.description: The shapeable slots on every weapon, listed in order starting at Slot 0. The engine addresses them by position, so the order is part of the contract.

RequiredProficiencyLevel.description: Minimum proficiency level on the weapon before this slot can be shaped.

RequiresMastery.description: Whether the weapon must be mastered before this slot can be shaped.

DustCostPerRank.description: Indexed by the rank being bought, so entry 3 is the cost of going from rank 2 to rank 3. Entry 0 is unused. Must be at least as long as the longest ValuePerRank, or the top ranks can never be bought. An empty list disables refining.

OptionCount.description: How many alternatives a reshape offers. The player may always keep the current perk instead.

Clear.description: Restoring the slot to the perk the proficiency file defines.

LunarAscensionOrb.description: Item that instantly refines a perk to its maximum rank. ItemId 0 means no such item is configured.

Options.description: The effects a shape or reshape may roll.

Id.description: Stable identity. A player's shaped perk stores this, never the array position, so the file can be reordered freely. Must be unique and non-zero, and must NEVER be reused for a different option: that would silently convert every perk players rolled from the old one.

TypeName.description: Documentation only. The validator checks it against Type.

Unit.description: Documentation only, checked against Type. Percent values are FRACTIONS: 0.10 is 10%.

Weight.description: Relative draw chance among the options a roll may pick from. Must be above 0, or the option could never be rolled.

ValuePerRank.description: Indexed by rank. Entry 0 is what a freshly shaped slot rolls; the last entry is this option's maximum rank. Must never decrease as the rank goes up.

SkillId.description: A CipbiaSkills_t, NOT the server's skills_t. An id outside the Cipbia set is rejected at load.
